There are a few costume designs, feel free to choose the one you like between "衣装01,04,05,06,07". (05 is the girl turns into a kid look)

I really like this kind of style of yours: (https://twitter.com/hureiaperopero/status/1613901361254662148) , so if possible, I would love this request to have a similar style to this, bright and warm colors. Of course, it doesn't need to be as refined a painting as this one.
